responsibility: This file lowers D declarations and symbols into GCC declarations and types. It handles name mangling, creation of FUNCTION_DECL/PARM_DECL/RESULT_DECL/VAR_DECL/TYPE_DECL nodes, function parameter and result layout, field and helper decl creation, declaration finalization, and object-file properties such as COMDAT/weak linkage, visibility, dllimport/dllexport, and template-instantiation emission policy. It is the primary owner of how D symbols become backend entities suitable for debugging, code generation, and linkage.
